verdict.rationale: Neon documents an official serverless driver (title only in the pack) and a programmatic `@neon/config-runtime` package for running neon.ts inspect/plan/apply from scripts. Agent Skills say they cover Neon's 'SDKs'. The Management API publishes an OpenAPI spec explicitly 'for codegen', which implies some developers generate their own clients rather than use an official SDK. missing for 10: evidence of an official Management API SDK in named languages, substantive SDK documentation beyond page titles, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
